properties.name: bloodconnect.jwt.secret
properties.description: Base64 or raw string secret used for HMAC SHA JWT token signing.

properties.name: bloodconnect.otp.expiration
properties.description: Duration for which a generated OTP remains valid.

properties.name: bloodconnect.otp.resend-cooldown
properties.description: Cooldown period before a user can request another OTP.

properties.name: bloodconnect.otp.max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum failed verification attempts allowed per OTP.

properties.name: bloodconnect.otp.max-resends
properties.description: Maximum number of times an OTP can be resent.

properties.name: bloodconnect.sendgrid.api-key
properties.description: SendGrid API key for transactional emails.

properties.name: bloodconnect.sendgrid.from-email
properties.description: Outbound sender email address for SendGrid.

properties.name: bloodconnect.official.mail
properties.description: Official communication email address for BloodConnect.

properties.name: bloodconnect.official.sms-sender
properties.description: Sender header/tag for official dispatch SMS.

properties.name: bloodconnect.twilio.account-sid
properties.description: Twilio account SID for SMS routing.

properties.name: bloodconnect.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed origins for CORS headers.

properties.name: bloodconnect.seed-test-accounts
properties.description: Flag to seed initial demonstration and test accounts.
